# netbox_device_tag (Resource)

Attaches a single tag to a device, like aws_ec2_tag in the AWS provider: use it to tag a device that is created and managed outside of Terraform (onboarding automation, the NetBox UI) without taking ownership of the rest of the device. A netbox_device resource for the same device fights this resource — its updates strip every tag its own configuration does not declare — unless it sets lifecycle { ignore_changes = [tags] }. Import as <device id>/<tag slug>.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_site" "test" {
  name = "test-site"
}

resource "netbox_manufacturer" "test" {
  name = "test-manufacturer"
}

resource "netbox_device_type" "test" {
  manufacturer_id = netbox_manufacturer.test.id
  model           = "test-device-type"
}

resource "netbox_device_role" "test" {
  name = "test-device-role"
}

resource "netbox_tag" "test" {
  name = "test-tag"
}

# The device is managed elsewhere or its tags are left alone: a netbox_device that declares tags
# strips every tag it does not list, so it must ignore them.
resource "netbox_device" "test" {
  name           = "test-device"
  device_type_id = netbox_device_type.test.id
  role_id        = netbox_device_role.test.id
  site_id        = netbox_site.test.id

  lifecycle {
    ignore_changes = [tags]
  }
}

resource "netbox_device_tag" "test" {
  device_id = netbox_device.test.id
  tag_slug  = netbox_tag.test.slug
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (Number) Id of the device.
- `tag_slug` (String) Slug of the tag. The tag must already exist.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) <device id>/<tag slug>.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# <device id>/<tag slug>
import {
  to = netbox_device_tag.test
  id = "123/test-tag"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <device id>/<tag slug>
terraform import netbox_device_tag.test 123/test-tag
```
